title: Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview
abstract: arXiv:2611.29905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. translated_title: 基于领域预览弥合持续学习与测试时自适应之间的差距
translated_abstract: 领域偏移是训练机器学习模型面临的一个重大问题。虽然持续学习（CL）假设训练阶段存在分布偏移，持续测试时自适应（CTTA）考虑测试阶段出现的新领域，但需要在训练和测试两个阶段都进行显式在线领域偏移适应的设置仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了带领域预览的持续学习（CL-P），这是CL与TTA的一种新组合，其中训练数据和测试数据都受到分布偏移的影响。CL-P的训练阶段类似于领域增量学习，而测试阶段则包括在一个未来领域上的TTA阶段（我们称之为“预览”），以及一个在所有已见领域上的评估阶段。因此，模型必须在训练和测试时都能适应新领域。在本文中，我们评估了仅在训练时或仅在测试时进行适应的主流CL和TTA方法，以及它们的简单组合。实验表明，TTA会严重损害CL方法所适应的领域……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“带领域预览的持续学习（CL-P）”的新设置，要求模型在训练和测试两个阶段都需在线适应领域分布偏移，并系统评估了主流持续学习与测试时自适应方法及其简单组合在该设置下的表现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a new setting called Continual Learning with domain Preview (CL-P), where models must adapt online to domain shifts during both training and testing, and evaluates mainstream CL and TTA methods as well as their naive combination under this setting.
